title: Run small, poor quality. Cancelled my subscription.
text: These run very small. Yes ordered up a size but should have ordered up two. So if you want this subscription, make sure you do that. Overall the leggings didn’t impress me enough that i wanted to continue with the subscription in a larger size. They are very thin but soft. Not very sturdy, though. Kind of a bummer because I thought this would be fun. Oh well, worth a try!
label: neutral
